body.p: Your mobile phone includes Night Mode to help you take brighter, clearer photos in low-light conditions.

ol.li: Open the Camera app on your mobile phone.
Swipe to select the Night Mode option.
Frame your subject and hold the phone steady.
Tap the shutter button to take a photo.

body.p: When Night Mode is active, battery usage may increase during camera use. For more information about power usage, see Battery and Charging.
